News of Anthropic's blockbuster IPO and Coreweave results helped fuel sentiment but markets also grappled with post midterm capital rotation before being hit by a scandal involving Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang. The Opening Trade spoke to market experts and industry leaders as a volatile week rattled the AI trade but could see Europe benefit from recent market turmoil as investors seek safe harbour. (Source: Bloomberg)
